**Finding: MISSING (medium) — Post-termination transition assistance and data return**

**What I found.** This is a hosting/licensing agreement in which TrueLink holds our Web Site, Client Content and Credit Data on its own servers (§3(a) storage, §3(f) daily backups, §8(d) license to store Credit Data). Despite that:

- §14 (Termination) only addresses how long TrueLink keeps providing services after our notice — nothing about our data.
- §13 (Term) actually pushes the exit burden entirely onto us: "Client is responsible for arranging for a new name server within 30 days… a new hosting environment within 60 days."
- §10 (Confidentiality) imposes confidentiality duties but no return-of-materials or deletion obligation.
- No transition, export, migration or deletion language appears anywhere in the document.

**Redline (validated, ok:true).** Inserted a new §14(a) immediately after the termination paragraph — which survives termination under §24 ("Sections 1 and 5 through 30… will survive") — requiring TrueLink to: (i) provide up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, including migration cooperation; (ii) return all Client Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format within 30 days of request; and (iii) thereafter delete it from systems and backups and certify deletion in writing, subject to a narrow legal-retention carve-out.

**Fallback flagged in the comment:** 90 days of assistance, provided the 30-day export and deletion certification survive intact.
